summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K summarizing routine purchases of its own shares on the open market via Goldman Sachs International from May 5 to May 15, 2026. The company bought small blocks at prices ranging from $139.30 to $150.60 per share, totaling fewer than 24,000 shares. The purchases were made under existing shareholder authority and shares will be cancelled. No tender offer, premium, special strategic event, or unusual capital return program is announced. This is a standard issuer repurchase, not a special situation.
